parsed.summary: Dr. Minji Sohl has approved the revised test schedule for Sprint 2 but emphasizes that the environment is not considered ready until actual validation is achieved. She requests the vendor timeline in writing to assess confidence in the stakeholder demo date.

decisions.label: not ready
decisions.anchorText: I am not treating the environment as ready until we have actual validation in the path we will demonstrate.

warnings: The environment is not considered ready until actual validation is achieved.
Confidence in the stakeholder demo date depends on receiving the vendor timeline in writing.
